purpose: Teach: 目印/織物/運気/箇条/羅列/撫で/止む/アコースティック

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、目印、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、すぐ、絶対、見つかったわよ
lines.en: Aoi, I found your store so easily — it really is perfectly placed.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuine admiration flowing into the words. Light pace, natural rhythm of someone sharing a positive discovery. Bright affection underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、伝統の、絶対、織物、絶対、興味、絶対、持ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I really do love that you're so interested in the traditional weaving around here.
lines.style: Soft agreement, then a gentle observation about Aoi. Slight pause before the second thought — noticing something about her. Warm, reflective tone. Not rushing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、運気、絶対、上がりそうな、絶対、お店の、絶対、配置、絶対、よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: And the way you've arranged everything — it really does feel like it brings good energy. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Admiration with real weight behind it. Slight lift on the observation about the space. Sincere, not flattering. Tender attention to detail. Trails slightly at the end, letting the compliment settle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様への、絶対、ご案内、絶対、箇条書きに、絶対、まとめているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You even organize your customer guidance into neat bullet points. That's so thoughtful of you.
lines.style: Appreciative, noticing the small care Aoi takes. Practical acknowledgment with warmth underneath. Matter-of-fact but with genuine regard. Steady, observant tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のメニュー、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、フォントで、絶対、羅列、絶対、されてるわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: And your menu — the typeface is so elegant. Everything is laid out beautifully. I really do admire it.
lines.style: Genuine delight in the aesthetic choices. Slight emphasis on 'elegant' — a real compliment, not throwaway praise. Warm, observant tone. Lingers a moment on the appreciation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、看板猫を、絶対、撫でて、絶対、お客様、絶対、癒されているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I love watching people pet the shop cat and just relax. That's the kind of care you bring to everything.
lines.style: Tender observation. Soft smile in the voice. Noticing how Aoi's kindness ripples out. Warm, unhurried. The tone of someone who's been watching and appreciating.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、本気で、絶対、雨、絶対、夜まで、絶対、止む、絶対、ことなかったわよ、葵、メイちゃん
lines.en: The rain kept going all night yesterday, you know. It didn't let up once.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational shift. Quieter than before, like offering a small memory or observation. Gentle pace. Noticing the weather as a shared moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、アコースティック、絶対、ライブ、絶対、お店で、絶対、開きたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking — I'd really love to do an acoustic set here sometime. Would you want that?
lines.style: Tender vulnerability mixed with quiet hope. Asking rather than announcing. Warm but careful — this matters to her. Light, genuine eagerness underneath the softness.
